title.en: Petri nets: weighted firing and markings

summary: Make enabling, conflict and marking updates visible without confusing moving beads with tokens in transit.
objective: Build a weighted place-transition net where I can edit an initial marking, inspect enabled transitions and fire one transition atomically.
intent_signals: Build a weighted place-transition net where I can edit an initial marking, inspect enabled transitions and fire one transition atomically.
example_prompts: Build a weighted place-transition net where I can edit an initial marking, inspect enabled transitions and fire one transition atomically.
negative_signals: No timed, stochastic, colored or capacity-constrained net; total token count need not be conserved. Finite exploration is not a liveness or boundedness proof.
not_for: No timed, stochastic, colored or capacity-constrained net; total token count need not be conserved. Finite exploration is not a liveness or boundedness proof.

entities.name: Places and transitions
entities.guidance: Use shallow round token trays and rectangular transition bars with labeled weighted arrows. Token-stack height represents integer count at fixed scale; larger counts collapse to a numeric badge.

entities.name: Marking inspector
entities.guidance: Pin the exact before/after vectors beside an enabledness table. Optional history trays occupy explicit discrete-step layers, not physical elapsed time.

state_contract.model: Finite places P and transitions T; Pre and Post are nonnegative integer matrices; M∈N^|P|. Unlimited place capacity, no inhibitor/reset arcs and no timing. Transition t is enabled iff M≥Pre[:,t], componentwise; commit M′=M−Pre[:,t]+Post[:,t]. Store marking snapshots and chosen transition IDs.
state_contract.authority: The typed domain model owns each committed state and result. Geometry, labels and selection derive from that model; animation cannot certify a claim.
actions: Change nonnegative initial token counts or arc weights, then reset history.
Select a transition to preview required/produced tokens; fire only when enabled.
Explore two transitions competing for one input token; step back by restoring a snapshot.

invariants: Disabled firing is rejected without any count change; re-evaluate enablement after every commit.
After one competing transition consumes the only token, the other is disabled unless the committed outputs replenish its input.
For Pre=[2,0], Post=[0,1], M=[2,0], one firing gives [0,1]; M=[1,0] is disabled. A solution of the aggregate marking equation alone is not a reachable firing sequence.
motion_guidance: Step commits one semantic action; pause freezes presentation and leaves the committed state inspectable. Reset cancels pending playback and restores the complete starting state.
Offer a static transition highlight and an equivalent readable table for reduced motion. Camera travel is presentation, not an inference or domain operation.
creative_affordances: Use shallow sculptural cards, restrained materials and selective focus to expose relationships. Prefer a flat readable layout whenever depth has no declared role.
known_limits: No timed, stochastic, colored or capacity-constrained net; total token count need not be conserved. Finite exploration is not a liveness or boundedness proof.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no generated artifact, solver integration, runtime behavior or visual check has run.

physical_contract.scope: Abstract symbols and logical state; mesh contact, light and motion have no causal role in the model.

object_craft.structure: Use shallow round token trays and rectangular transition bars with labeled weighted arrows. Token-stack height represents integer count at fixed scale; larger counts collapse to a numeric badge.
object_craft.material: Matte surfaces and high-contrast labels; distinguish status with text and border style as well as color.

claims.statement: For weighted P/T nets without capacity limits, input token multiplicities determine enabling and firing subtracts input weights and adds output weights. The aggregate marking equation is necessary but not sufficient for reachability.
claims.scope: Unlimited-capacity specialization of the tutorial occurrence rule; no inhibitor arcs.

source_refs.locator: Printed pages 89–90, formal definition and occurrence rule; 97–98, marking equation
